title: Jo Iijima: one loud wordmark, everything else whispers
note: A sideways strip of tall posters (Bad Bunny, Times Square billboards) with a two-line grey caption under each. Above them the bio, services, clients and agencies are four columns of tiny grey mono text. The only loud thing is a hand-made, multicoloured, wobbly JO IIJIMA wordmark top left and a little spinning cube. Readymag Websites of the Year 2025, team choice. Worth taking: let the work and one hand-made mark be loud, and keep the interface quiet and small.
